description: The Q_beta ladder eigenphase alpha = (z-1)h/2 is bar-odd exactly when z is bar-even. Under convention C it is; under convention D (full-bar, bar(z) = z - h) it is not, with an exact z-independent defect bar(alpha)+alpha = h^2/2. So eigenphase_bar_involution — which every bar-parity fact in the c_k record sits downstream of — is a convention-C statement. The forced bar-odd projection alpha - h^2/4 improves the D-frame extraction substantially but does NOT restore the C-frame numbers: necessary, not sufficient.
scope: scope-(a). Nothing wired; no c_k value or tier changes. This does NOT license searching for further corrections until one lands near the proved c_2 = -1 — that would be a fit.

assertions.name: 1_C_eigenphase_is_bar_odd
assertions.detail: bar(alpha)+alpha = 0 under convention C (z_C bar-even) — eigenphase_bar_involution holds

assertions.name: 2_D_eigenphase_defect_is_exactly_h_squared_over_2
assertions.detail: bar(alpha)+alpha = (q - 1)**2*(q + 1)**2/(2*q**2) under convention D — not bar-odd

result.derived_correction: alpha_odd = alpha - h^2/4 (bar-odd projection; no free parameter)
result.verdict: The C->D move cannot be a z-substitution: swapping z into the C-frame alpha keeps the formula while breaking the bar parity its downstream consumers assume. The bar-odd projection is the forced correction and is insufficient alone; the two-row (Wenzl level r=2) cap is not folded in here and is the remaining piece of qou-cds1.
